title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国超大规模云厂商资本开支下调30%-40%，如何布局？
speaker: Ellie Jiang

segments.en: For more, let's bring in Ellie John, Macquarie Capitals head of Asia Internet and Media Research.
segments.zh: 更多内容，有请麦格理资本亚洲互联网与媒体研究主管Ellie John。

segments.en: What to do now? It's been a crazy few weeks.
segments.zh: 现在该怎么办？这几周市场波动很大。

segments.en: It did. It's been extremely difficult, especially when investors looking at all of these chaos happening around the world.
segments.zh: 确实如此。这段时间非常艰难，尤其是市场参与者面对全球各种混乱局面时。

segments.en: Right. The most question we've been getting is what to do with China CapEx.
segments.zh: 对。我们被问得最多的是中国资本开支该怎么办。

segments.en: How are these companies are investing their, you know, AI sort of dollars into the future and how do we really picture that future growth stories.
segments.zh: 这些公司如何将AI相关资金投向未来，以及我们如何真正描绘未来的增长故事。

segments.en: One thing we are noting is that these Chinese hyperscalers have been diversifying their procurement channels for many, many years.
segments.zh: 我们注意到的一点是，这些中国超大规模企业多年来一直在多元化采购渠道。

segments.en: For companies like Alibaba, they also own their proprietary T headship that has been sort of defending a bit, right.
segments.zh: 像阿里巴巴这样的公司，也拥有自己的专有技术领导力，这在一定程度上起到了防御作用。

segments.en: In terms of that future turbulence. But immediately we have been slashing our CapEx forecast across the major BAT, Bava, by Tenzen, by around 30 to 40 percent to factor that ongoing headwinds, especially in 227, 28.
segments.zh: 面对未来的市场波动，我们已大幅下调主要BAT、百度、腾讯的资本开支预测约30%至40%，以反映持续的压力，尤其是2027、2028年。

segments.en: And of course, in response to that, the data center workload will also take a hit because potentially we are looking at a slower moving.
segments.zh: 当然，相应地，数据中心工作量也会受到影响，因为可能我们看到超大规模企业的支出放缓。

segments.en: Right from the hyperscalers. Now, what to do.
segments.zh: 对，来自超大规模企业的变化。那么现在该怎么做？

segments.en: I mean, the idea that when we're looking at 2027 is that we still do anticipate a lot of turbulence, especially external, of altilities that will continue for some time.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，当我们展望2027年时，我们仍然预计会有很多市场波动，尤其是外部的不确定性将持续一段时间。

segments.en: But at the same time, we're sort of recommending investors to return back to this investment 101, where we do think fundamental matters more at this point.
segments.zh: 但同时，我们建议市场参与者回归基本原则，我们认为此时基本面更为重要。

segments.en: In 227, we highlight the key work to our durability.
segments.zh: 在2027年，我们强调持久性的关键作用。

segments.en: We think the companies that have steady earnings, disabilities have better cash flow inflection point, such as the CSPs potentially they have richer cash balance to really rather through the storm, right, in the coming month.
segments.zh: 我们认为，拥有稳定收益和较好现金流拐点的公司，例如CSP，可能有更充裕的现金余额来抵御未来几个月的市场波动。

segments.en: So that is really a place that we recommend investors to somewhat hide from the ongoing external turbulence.
segments.zh: 因此，这确实是我们建议市场参与者在一定程度上避开持续外部波动的地方。

segments.en: Do you think when it comes to the US regulatory side of things, is the tightness scrutiny still going to be the biggest overhang?
segments.zh: 你认为在美国监管方面，严格的审查仍将是最大的压力吗？
